reason: d8f13b36b1 replaces the shared REPL stack passed to hooks with throwaway Stack::with_parent values whose overlay and environment state is copied. cd00a489af merges the child back and exercises that path with env_change_overlay, activating an overlay in a hook and reading its variable afterward.

5f0ad1d6ad^ blames alias_offset[flat_idx] on b6959197bf. try_find_alias records offsets per alias, whereas NuCompleter indexes by the flattened expression position; the fix adds completion tests including alias ll = ls -l followed by ll t.

db3177a5aa adds the early break, but the parent already discards pipeline.print's nonzero result and returns empty PipelineData after a finite loop. 54a18991ab adds tests checking that the next script statement does not run, which verify propagation of a failure the earlier finite-loop path also swallowed.

9b99b2f6ac introduces Stack::add_overlay removing the overlay's env_hidden entry, which subsequent environment lookup uses to suppress hidden names. 3ed3712fdc adds overlay_preserve_hidden_env cases that hide a variable and reactivate the overlay, and separates ordinary activation from reload.

c06ef201b7 introduces a Waitable that blocks until set and uses it for the plugin Hello handshake. The getter holds the shared state even after the input manager exits without setting it; c52884b3c8 adds writer-drop signaling and a subprocess case that exits before Hello.

5d9e2455f7 introduces the unchecked RHS block access in parse_pipeline, and the panic needs the recovering parser to supply an empty block. The test in 1f06f8405c uses a blank EngineState without Let or Mut declarations, so parse_let cannot build the RHS call and parse_pipeline cannot reach the access.

761946c522 casts the signed range endpoints to usize and can clamp an inclusive endpoint to cols.len() in the same merge block. cdc4fb1011 tests negative and open-ended ranges as well as preservation of existing headers for 0..1.

fcc13224c1 introduces replace_headers assigning every header to every row after discarding the row's actual column names. f38657e6f3 adds a row with z in place of y and checks that to nuon emits no value for the missing y header, which requires preserving the name-to-value association across the two rows.

f3bb1d11d3 introduces use_aliases calling the declaration visibility setter with an AliasId, leaving alias visibility hidden on reimport. 8a9cc33aac changes it to use_alias_id and adds hides_alias_import_then_reimports.

aa7d7d0cc3 introduces parts_including_redirection chaining ordinary and redirect spans out of source order. The let/mut parser feeds those spans into ordered span concatenation, and f3a1dfef95 adds the two redirection-before-equals crash regressions.

Blame attributes the switch from the full call-head span to get_decl(...).name() to 0a990ed105, which already had module-prefixed imports. The added test requires successful cargo check help on stdout, and eval bypasses built-in help for known externals so an old run attempts check instead.
